cutoff: 10:00 Europe/Copenhagen on delivery day minus one
inputs: previous-day and previous-week full price curves for DK1, DK2, DE-LU, NL, SE4; calendar
selection: highest development ±5% hit rate for abs(actual)>=20 EUR/MWh; MAE tie-breaker
caveats: All periods previously explored; no independent confirmatory test.
Prior-day prices assume day-ahead results were published before next-day 10:00; historical exceptional delays not audited.
Current price archives may include revisions.
DST repeated clock hour averaged and missing clock hour interpolated for curve training; actual hours evaluated separately.
15-minute market prices averaged hourly; not a quarter-hour forecast.
Timestamp filtering alone does not prove the forecast archive is immutable or that availability timestamps are accurate.
No weather, fuel or TSO forecasts included unless an explicit forecast file is supplied.
